title: M.Tech Civil Engineering | KSDS KPGU
content: Admission Inquiry Academics / KSDS Civil Engineering Krishna School of Diploma Studies prepares civil engineering diploma students with applied infrastructure knowledge and field-focused learning. LEADERSHIP NOTE Message From the HOD KSDS Ms. Komal Ketan Dave Head of Department, Civil Engineering hod.civil.ksds@kpgu.ac.in On behalf of our students and faculty, it is my privilege to welcome all of you to the Department of Civil Engineering at Krishna School of Diploma Studies (KSDS). The department of civil engineering at KPGU is well established with high quality laboratories and a rich blend of traditional and modern equipment. Our faculty members from specialized fields are dedicated to teaching, industry interaction, and professional development. The department acts as a hub where all stakeholders collaborate in optimizing teaching-learning processes and practical exposure, helping students become capable professionals and responsible contributors. ABOUT DEPARTMENT Civil Engineering at KSDS 01 Drs. Kiran and Pallavi Patel Global University, formerly known as Babaria Institute of Technology, was established in the year 2004 and the Department of Civil Engineering has been part of it since inception. 02 Civil Engineering is among the core and promising engineering branches, creating opportunities in infrastructure and development across sectors. 03 The department has grown tremendously over the years and is now one of the major engineering departments of the institute. VALUES & GOALS Vision & Mission Vision Krishna School of Diploma Studies envisages a technical school offering value driven skill development program and consistent high degree of professional development of students leading to responsible global citizens. 01 To inculcate collaborative and innovative culture in students by offering best quality education. 02 To excel them in engineering and technology domain by excellent teaching learning process. 03 To provide innovative environment to learn, innovate and create new ideas for the betterment of oneself and global society. 04 To develop good responsible citizen through ethics and eco-friendly culture.
